breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. While it correctly calculated the Reynolds number (Re_x = 2,000,000), it did not recognize that this value signifies a turbulent, not laminar, boundary layer. It then proceeded to use the incorrect laminar correlation (δ = 5x / sqrt(Re_x)) from the original prompt, directly contradicting the ground truth's instruction to use a turbulent correlation.
